prairies.terrain: Open rolling grassland cut by low rises and scattered treelines, the softest ground in the game and the first any player walks.
prairies.entrance: The grass nearest the entrance grazes soft and Pale, wide sightlines and slow, dumb prey underfoot.
prairies.deep_end: The far side of the plain runs harder: Pale wanders thicker and bolder the further you walk from the entrance, and every Dusk in the biome is penned in a guarded pocket.
prairies.lair: A low earthen mound at the plain's far edge, scorched bare and ringed in old bone; whichever champion you raised, it dens here.
pockets: A marsh hollow ringed by reeds, thick with Dusk prey and patrolled by a pack that aggroes together the moment one of them spots you.
A dense treeline thicket at the plain's edge, hiding a knot of Dusk stalkers that scatter and regroup rather than break.

wetlands.terrain: Marsh and standing water threaded through reed-choked channels, the first ground in the game that asks for Fins.
wetlands.entrance: The shallows nearest the entrance still graze soft, Pale wandering the mud in easy reach of dry ground.
wetlands.deep_end: Push past the reeds and the water gets deep and mean: Dusk wanders freely out here, and Deep hides in the hollows below the surface.
wetlands.lair: A drowned hummock deep in the marsh, black water lapping at a ring of picked-clean bones.
pockets: A deep marsh hollow where the water holds still and dark; Old Gillmaw holds the mudbank there, and it does not give the ground back once it has it.
A reed-choked backwater thick with Deep prey, guarded by a pack that closes in from every channel at once.

mountains.terrain: Rocky slopes rising toward bare stone and a cold, thin-aired summit, the first ground that asks for both Claws and Coat.
mountains.entrance: The lower slopes near the entrance still graze soft and Pale, easy footing before the rock steepens.
mountains.deep_end: Climb higher and the mountain runs harder: Dusk and Deep wander the mid-slopes freely, and Rage clusters only in the guarded ground above.
mountains.lair: A wind-scoured cave mouth near the summit, bones scattered across the frost-cracked stone.
pockets: A boulder-field at the foot of the rocky outcrop, where the crag-holder holds the approach; ground any player can walk into, no climbing required.
A stand of stunted trees in the foothills, below the lethal cold line, where the shaggy grazer-hunter dens among the roots.
A treeline thicket higher up hiding a knot of Rage prey, guarded by a pack that swarms from the underbrush.

beach.terrain: Sun-bleached sand and tide pools running out to volcanic vents along the shore, the first ground to run the full wild ladder in the open.
beach.entrance: The dry sand near the entrance still grazes soft and Pale, gulls-and-crabs country before the vents start smoking.
beach.deep_end: Walk the tideline out and the sand runs mean: Deep and Rage wander freely out here, the full ladder loose on open ground.
beach.lair: A blackened dune scarred by old vent-fire, bones half-buried in the ash-grey sand.
pockets: A cluster of volcanic vents smoking along the shore, where the vent-dweller holds its seam and does not back off from the heat or the fight.
A tide-pool basin cut off at high water, thick with Rage prey and a pack that swarms in from the surrounding dunes.

volcanic.terrain: Cracked black rock and rivers of slow lava, the hardest ground in the game, and the only biome whose deep end runs Rage from edge to edge.
volcanic.entrance: The cooled black rock nearest the entrance still grazes soft and Pale, easy footing before the ground starts to glow.
volcanic.deep_end: Push toward the caldera and the rock runs murderous: Deep and Rage wander together out here, and the ground itself will kill you if the meat doesn't.
volcanic.lair: A cracked caldera rim glowing dull red at the edges, bones fused into the cooled black glass.
pockets: A lava-rimmed shelf where an elite holds the ledge over the flow, a knot of Rage prey penned behind it.
An ash gully choked with heat-shimmer, hiding a pack of Rage prey that swarms out of the smoke together.
